title: Apple Watch dataset
description: Extracted Apple Watch product data. See data/rules/apple-watch.md for what must be extracted.

devices.description: One entry per Apple Watch model.

image.description: An image variant: original Apple URL plus the local copy served from this repo. Canvas dimensions and transparent padding are preserved from Apple's original file.

url.description: Original Apple-hosted image URL; the app may fetch directly from Apple.

file.description: Public path of the local copy in this repo.

name.description: Colour name exactly as Apple displays it.

swatch.description: The single-colour circle preview: CSS colour value or Apple-hosted swatch image URL.

images.description: Product images for this colour and its variants.

label.description: Optional qualifier when a model lists several weights, e.g. "41mm case".

name.description: Model name exactly as Apple displays it.

priceAud.description: Cheapest available starting price in AUD.

colors.description: Every colour found in the HTML.

alwaysOnDisplay.description: Whether the display supports Always On.

brightness.description: All brightness specifications bundled together as entries; include minimum brightness where present.

wideAngleDisplay.description: Whether the display has wide-angle capability, or null when not applicable or unspecified.

weight.description: Usually one entry per size or material combination.

thickness.description: Case thickness exactly as Apple displays it.

u1UwbChip.description: U1/UWB wireless chip details, or null when absent.

otherWirelessChip.description: Other wireless chip details, or null when absent.

hasSpeaker.description: Whether the model has a speaker.

hasSiren.description: Whether the model has a siren.

waterResistanceDepth.description: Rated water resistance depth, or null when not rated by depth.

ipRating.description: IP rating exactly as Apple displays it, or null when no IP rating applies.
